description: This source file contains Python test code utilizing pytest to validate the functionality of the SlidevTemplate class and related project initialization logic within a larger software project. The tests cover project setup, configuration loading, template variable replacement, project output verification, and registration of the template. It also includes fixtures to prepare test environments and mock files. Overall, it is a test suite for the Slidev template component.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration for a project, including name, version, description, author, type, output path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration of project types, including SLIDEV.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data structure holding environment setup commands, build commands, dependencies, environment info, initialization scripts, and other project-specific info.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing a project based on configuration and templates, including loading config, copying template files, replacing variables, and running post-processing scripts.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Provides templates based on the project type or directory, facilitating template retrieval and registration.

classes.name: SlidevTemplate
classes.description: Template class for slidev projects, providing methods for getting init info, validating parameters, and performing project setup tasks.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads project configuration data from a JSON or YAML file, returning a ProjectConfig instance.

methods.name: get_init_info
methods.description: Retrieves initialization information for the template, including commands and configs.

methods.name: validate_parameters
methods.description: Validates input parameters for the template. For Slidev, this is straightforward, returning True.

methods.name: initialize_project
methods.description: Main method to create project files, execute commands, replace variables, and run post-processing scripts.

methods.name: wait_for_post_process_completed
methods.description: Waits for the post-processing script to complete execution.
